lines.text: Every January, thousands of middle schoolers sit down for the same math contest.
lines.caption: Every January, thousands of middle schoolers sit down for the same math contest.

lines.text: Twenty-five questions. Forty minutes. And one rule that most kids miss.
lines.caption: Twenty-five questions. Forty minutes. And one rule that most kids miss.

lines.text: Hi, I'm Vantee. Let's get you ready for the AMC 8!
lines.caption: Hi, I'm Vantee. Let's get you ready for the AMC 8!

lines.text: AMC stands for American Mathematics Competitions.
lines.caption: AMC stands for American Mathematics Competitions.

lines.text: The AMC 8 is for students in grade eight or below.
lines.caption: The AMC 8 is for students in grade eight or below.

lines.text: It's held every January, at your school or another host site.
lines.caption: It's held every January, at your school or another host site.

lines.text: No calculators allowed. Just you, a pencil, and scratch paper.
lines.caption: No calculators allowed. Just you, a pencil, and scratch paper.

lines.text: The questions start friendly, and get harder as you go.
lines.caption: The questions start friendly, and get harder as you go.

lines.text: There are twenty-five multiple choice questions, each with five choices, A to E.
lines.caption: There are twenty-five multiple choice questions, each with five choices, A to E.

lines.text: You get forty minutes. That's about ninety-six seconds per question.
lines.caption: You get forty minutes. That's about ninety-six seconds per question.

lines.text: Each right answer earns one point. The top score is twenty-five.
lines.caption: Each right answer earns one point. The top score is twenty-five.

lines.text: Here's the rule most kids miss: a wrong answer costs you NOTHING.
lines.caption: Here's the rule most kids miss: a wrong answer costs you NOTHING.

lines.text: A blank also scores zero. So a blank can never beat a guess.
lines.caption: A blank also scores zero. So a blank can never beat a guess.

lines.text: A wild guess has a one in five chance. Cross out two choices, and it's one in three.
lines.caption: A wild guess has a one in five chance. Cross out two choices, and it's one in three.

lines.text: The top five percent of scorers make the Honor Roll.
lines.caption: The top five percent of scorers make the Honor Roll.

lines.text: The top one percent make the Distinguished Honor Roll.
lines.caption: The top one percent make the Distinguished Honor Roll.

lines.text: Strategy one: pace yourself.
lines.caption: Strategy one: pace yourself.

lines.text: The first ten questions are usually quicker. Aim to finish them in about ten minutes.
lines.caption: The first ten questions are usually quicker. Aim to finish them in about ten minutes.

lines.text: That leaves thirty minutes for the last fifteen, where the hard ones live.
lines.caption: That leaves thirty minutes for the last fifteen, where the hard ones live.

lines.text: Stuck for more than two minutes? Circle it in your booklet, move on, and come back later.
lines.caption: Stuck for more than two minutes? Circle it in your booklet, move on, and come back later.

lines.text: Strategy two: read the question twice.
lines.caption: Strategy two: read the question twice.

lines.text: Circle what it asks for. Is it the area, or the perimeter? Feet, or inches?
lines.caption: Circle what it asks for. Is it the area, or the perimeter? Feet, or inches?

lines.text: Many wrong choices are the right answer to a different question.
lines.caption: Many wrong choices are the right answer to a different question.

lines.text: Strategy three: use the answer choices.
lines.caption: Strategy three: use the answer choices.

lines.text: Estimate first. Choices far from your estimate can go.
lines.caption: Estimate first. Choices far from your estimate can go.

lines.text: You can also plug a choice back into the question, and check it.
lines.caption: You can also plug a choice back into the question, and check it.

lines.text: Strategy four: never leave a question blank.
lines.caption: Strategy four: never leave a question blank.

lines.text: With two minutes left, fill in every blank with your best guess.
lines.caption: With two minutes left, fill in every blank with your best guess.

lines.text: Let's try one, AMC 8-style. What is one hundred ninety-eight times two hundred two?
lines.caption: Let's try one, AMC 8-style. What is one hundred ninety-eight times two hundred two?

lines.text: Choice A: thirty-nine thousand nine hundred ninety-six. B: forty thousand four.
lines.caption: Choice A: thirty-nine thousand nine hundred ninety-six. B: forty thousand four.

lines.text: Choice C: thirty-nine thousand two hundred four.
lines.caption: Choice C: thirty-nine thousand two hundred four.

lines.text: Choices D and E: forty thousand, and four thousand.
lines.caption: Choices D and E: forty thousand, and four thousand.

lines.text: No need to multiply it all out. Estimate first: two hundred times two hundred is forty thousand.
lines.caption: No need to multiply it all out. Estimate first: two hundred times two hundred is forty thousand.

lines.text: So four thousand is way off. Cross it out.
lines.caption: So four thousand is way off. Cross it out.

lines.text: Now the last digit. Eight times two is sixteen, so the answer ends in six.
lines.caption: Now the last digit. Eight times two is sixteen, so the answer ends in six.

lines.text: Only one choice ends in six: thirty-nine thousand nine hundred ninety-six.
lines.caption: Only one choice ends in six: thirty-nine thousand nine hundred ninety-six.

lines.text: Check: two hundred minus two, times two hundred plus two, is forty thousand minus four. It works!
lines.caption: Check: two hundred minus two, times two hundred plus two, is forty thousand minus four. It works!

lines.text: How do you get ready? Practice with real past AMC 8 problems.
lines.caption: How do you get ready? Practice with real past AMC 8 problems.

lines.text: Every few weeks, do a full set of twenty-five, with a forty-minute timer.
lines.caption: Every few weeks, do a full set of twenty-five, with a forty-minute timer.

lines.text: Then review every miss. Find the idea, not just the answer.
lines.caption: Then review every miss. Find the idea, not just the answer.

lines.text: Learn the big topics: counting, number puzzles, geometry, and early algebra.
lines.caption: Learn the big topics: counting, number puzzles, geometry, and early algebra.

lines.text: And try Vantee's AMC 8-style videos, with every solution and trap explained.
lines.caption: And try Vantee's AMC 8-style videos, with every solution and trap explained.

lines.text: So: twenty-five questions, forty minutes, and no penalty for guessing.
lines.caption: So: twenty-five questions, forty minutes, and no penalty for guessing.

lines.text: Pace yourself, read twice, use the choices, and answer every question.
lines.caption: Pace yourself, read twice, use the choices, and answer every question.

lines.text: Good luck on test day. You've got this!
lines.caption: Good luck on test day. You've got this!
